description: Site owner per-seat tactical-pick overrides. An override always wins over the automatic rule in src/tactical.ts; the seat panel still shows what the data-based rule would pick.
how_to_edit: Add an object to overrides[] with pcon24cd (ONS PCON24CD), party (any party name, e.g. "Conservative", "Reform UK", "Restore Britain", "Liberal Democrat", "Green", "SNP", "Plaid Cymru", "Independent"), optional note and at (ISO date).
An override naming Labour is ignored. The legacy endorse field (reform|restore|none|other:<label>) is still read.
Picks are computed in the browser at load time; no rebuild step is needed.
